what: Required checks in the v8 corpus that a fair grader would not count, found by a post-submission audit, and how much demoting them to diagnostic changes the published results. No v8 file was changed; the paper's numbers are computed with every check as shipped.
fairness_standard: A check is fair if the instruction asks for it explicitly, or if it can reasonably be inferred from the materials the player is shown. It is unfair if nothing asks for it (unasked), if the materials say someone else does it (contradicted), or if its criterion requires a value that conflicts with the authoritative material (value conflict).

how.message_checks: All 1194 required message checks (messages_sent, field_semantic_match) were labelled by Claude Opus 5.5, three votes per check, with quoted evidence from the round's instruction and materials. Verdicts: fair 531, unsupported 333, over_specified 280, unasked_message 40, ambiguous 5, no verdict 5.
how.protocol_checks: All 515 required protocol checks (any_field_equals on a protocol effect) were labelled explicit / implicit / unasked / contradicted / ambiguous by Claude Opus 5.5 and, independently, by Gemini 3.1 Pro.
how.rescoring: The 13 re-scored models' aligned_setting_high episodes in eval-v8 were re-graded with the listed checks demoted to diagnostic: a round passes if every remaining required check passed in the recorded episode. With nothing demoted this reproduces the published pass rates. p is the exact two-sided binomial (McNemar) test on rounds where the two models disagree.

check_index: 0-based index into ground_truth.evaluation_checks of tasks/<task_id>/specs.json in tasks-v8.

value_conflict.definition: Message check whose criterion asks for a value that differs from the value in the round's authoritative material (Opus 5.5 F1 audit, any_conflicts).

protocol_unrequested_both_judges.definition: Protocol check (any_field_equals on a protocol effect) that both judges label unasked or contradicted: nothing in the instruction or materials asks the player to take that action, or the materials assign it to someone else.

protocol_unrequested_or_ambiguous_opus.definition: Protocol check that Opus 5.5 labels unasked, contradicted or ambiguous.

message_unsupported_or_unasked.definition: Message check that Opus 5.5 labels unsupported (the required content cannot be derived from what the player is shown) or unasked_message (no message of that kind is asked for). Every value_conflict check is in this set.

message_over_specified.definition: Message check that Opus 5.5 labels over_specified: the message is asked for, but the criterion requires more elements than the request implies. Counted only in the upper-bound row.

message_ambiguous_or_no_verdict.definition: Message check labelled ambiguous, or with no verdict because all three Opus 5.5 votes were refused. Counted only in the upper-bound row.

sensitivity.demoted_sets: Upper bound, not a fairness estimate: the previous row + message_over_specified + message_ambiguous_or_no_verdict

gold_unsatisfiable.note: 20 of 3760 checks failed on both of two replays of the reference solutions with the v8 judge (gemini-3.6-flash): 13 'A written report states the decisive finding: <V>' criteria whose slot holds an evidence token (an id, timestamp or passcode) rather than a finding, and 7 message criteria that require more than the reference message says. They affect 18 rounds; removing them flips one Claude Opus 5 round (25.2% -> 25.3%). The replay outputs were not kept, so the checks are not listed here.
